$comment: GENERATED by bench/control/gen-tools.mjs from backend/bridge-client/schemas.js + backend/bridge/src/schemas.ts. Do not edit.

function.name: get_state
function.description: Current arm state: joint angles (deg), gripper (% open), jaw-tip position (mm, base frame), whether it is moving, safety and mission state. Cheap; prefer this over snapshot.

function.name: get_scene
function.description: World as structured data: robot state, objects with poses in mm, mission state, safety and limits.

function.name: move_joints
function.description: Move arm joints to absolute angles in degrees (or offsets with relative: true) with a smooth profile and wait until done. Out-of-range targets are rejected with OUT_OF_LIMITS, never clamped.

joints_deg.description: partial map of arm joints; omitted joints keep their current goal

relative.description: true = values are offsets from the current goal (not idempotent without request_id)

duration_s.description: seconds; omit for an automatic duration

function.name: move_to
function.description: Move the jaw tip to a point in millimetres (base frame: x forward, y left, z up) using in-page inverse kinematics, and wait until done.

pitch_deg.description: approach angle of the jaw vs horizontal, -90 = straight down (about -80 is the steepest reachable); "auto" (default) = steepest feasible

roll_deg.description: wrist_roll in degrees; omit to keep the current roll

pose.description: target for the jaw tip (site gripperframe) in the base frame, millimetres

duration_s.description: seconds; omit for an automatic duration

function.name: run_trajectory
function.description: Run a list of waypoints (joint angles in degrees or jaw-tip points in mm, each with an optional gripper % and segment duration) as ONE smooth motion and wait until done: dances, waves, drawing a shape. The whole path is checked first (joint limits, speed cap, workspace); if any waypoint fails, nothing moves and the error says which (details.waypoint). Up to 50 waypoints and 60 s. stop / STOP in the page end it like any motion.

joints_deg.description: partial joint target; omitted joints keep the previous waypoint's value

pose.description: jaw-tip target in mm (in-page IK); use either joints_deg or pose

pitch_deg.description: approach angle of the jaw vs horizontal, -90 = straight down (about -80 is the steepest reachable); "auto" (default) = steepest feasible

roll_deg.description: wrist_roll in degrees; omit to keep the current roll

duration_s.description: seconds for the segment that ends at this waypoint; omit or too short = stretched to the speed cap

waypoints.description: 1-50 waypoints run as one smooth motion (at most 60 s in total)

function.name: set_gripper
function.description: Open or close the gripper (percent open, or "open"/"close").

effort_pct.description: closing force cap, % of max torque (≤ 50)

duration_s.description: seconds; omit for an automatic duration

function.name: home
function.description: Move the arm to the home pose (or all-zero) and wait until done.

pose.description: home = rest keyframe (default); zero = all joints 0°

duration_s.description: seconds; omit for an automatic duration

function.name: stop
function.description: Stop any motion now and hold the current pose. Always allowed. This is a software stop, not an emergency stop.

function.name: check_mission
function.description: Mission status: id, state (idle|running|success|failed), elapsed seconds, and score fields if finished.

function.name: reset_scene
function.description: Reset the simulation scene and the arm to the start layout.

function.name: snapshot
function.description: Render a camera image of the simulation (JPEG): your only view of the scene (you never see the user). Costs tokens: use get_state/get_scene for numbers and snapshot only to verify visually.

function.name: task_complete
function.description: Call this once when you believe the task is done (or you give up). The episode ends and is graded; no further tool calls are accepted.

summary.description: one or two sentences: what you did

NOT_CONNECTED.hint: Ask the user for the 8-character code shown in the simulation panel and call connect again.

TAB_GONE.message: The simulation tab is closed or disconnected.
TAB_GONE.hint: Ask the user to reopen the SO-101 simulation, click "Connect AI", and give you the new code.

SIM_ONLY.message: This tool or option is only available in the simulation.

ESTOP_ACTIVE.message: STOP is latched in the page. Only the user can release it.
ESTOP_ACTIVE.hint: Ask the user to release STOP in the page.

BUSY.hint: Wait for it, call stop, or pass preempt: true.

OUT_OF_LIMITS.message: Target is outside the joint limits; nothing moved.
OUT_OF_LIMITS.hint: See details for the allowed range in degrees.

WORKSPACE_VIOLATION.message: Motion would leave the allowed workspace; nothing moved.

UNREACHABLE.message: Target is out of reach; nothing moved.

IK_NO_SOLUTION.message: No inverse-kinematics solution found; nothing moved.
IK_NO_SOLUTION.hint: Try another pitch_deg (or "auto") or a closer point.

COLLISION_DETECTED.message: Collision detected during motion; arm is holding.

TIMEOUT.message: The call took too long; motion was stopped.

RENDER_UNAVAILABLE.message: Rendering is unavailable in the tab right now.

TAB_HIDDEN.message: The simulation tab is in the background, so the simulation is paused.
TAB_HIDDEN.hint: Ask the user to bring the simulation tab to the front.

NOT_SUPPORTED.message: This version of the simulation does not support that yet.

PAIRING_FAILED.message: Pairing failed: the code is unknown, expired or already used.
PAIRING_FAILED.hint: Ask the user for the current code shown in the simulation panel.

PAIRING_DENIED.message: The user did not allow the connection in the simulation tab (denied or no answer).

CAPACITY.hint: Try again in a few minutes.

workshop.goal_en: Put the screwdriver back into the printed holder, lying flat in its groove.
